title: Nobody Claps
subtitle: Abstract-lines demo · 9:16 · 0:14 (ESTIMATED) — anchors come only from the script

nodes.label: Success is what you do when nobody claps
nodes.visual: One desk, one lamp, one sheet of paper — the same frame for the whole piece.
nodes.summary: The whole script is abstract, so almost every visual here is an anchor decision, not a shot decision.

nodes.label: Success isn't a straight line
nodes.anchor: a hundred small decisions nobody claps for
nodes.visual: A hundred pencil tally marks pressed into one sheet; the only line drawn through them is visibly jagged.
nodes.summary: The script answers its own abstraction in the next sentence — the tally marks are the line, and they are not straight.

nodes.label: A hundred tallies on one real sheet
nodes.visual: Pen on paper, overhead, no graphics. The count is carried by an object the speaker describes, not by a chart.
nodes.summary: The script counts decisions, so the number becomes marks a hand can actually make — not a dot grid.

nodes.label: Consistency compounds
nodes.visual: The same 6:00 alarm and the same framing three mornings running; only the light and the paper stack change.
nodes.summary: The anchor is a time the speaker actually names. The repetition across three mornings is the argument — no illustration required.

nodes.label: 6:00, three mornings, identical frame
nodes.visual: Alarm, hands, page — cut on the same beat each time. The third morning is the one that pays off.

nodes.label: Compounding is invisible while it happens
nodes.summary: Nothing in the script carries this line. Deliberately unresolved: hold on the speaker or let the words sit in type. No drifting particles, no seedling.

nodes.label: I keep a stack of every draft nobody saw
nodes.visual: Hands lift the actual stack; the top sheet is dated. Nothing is arranged for the camera.

nodes.label: A timelapse of the stack would read as a stock success montage
nodes.visual: Keep it static and slow. If the stack animates, the piece starts selling instead of admitting.

nodes.label: Show up when nobody is watching
nodes.visual: Back to the first frame — same desk, same sheet, one more tally mark added.
nodes.summary: Returns to the opening image so the loop closes without adding a new idea.

nodes.label: One desk, one lamp, phone overhead
nodes.visual: Natural light from a window at dawn for the 6am frames. No faces, no second location.
